# OmniaCSS — full guide for AI assistants

> OmniaCSS is a free, MIT-licensed, utility-first CSS framework built on modern CSS: container queries, anchor
> positioning, view transitions, scroll-driven animations, @starting-style, light-dark(), OKLCH colors and logical
> properties. It looks like Tailwind but is NOT Tailwind: the spacing scale and many class names differ. Its build
> (PostCSS, Vite or CLI) keeps only the classes a project uses. Components and page blocks come from the sister
> project OmniaUI (https://omniaui.eu, oc-* classes, HTML/React/Vue/Blade/Livewire).

OmniaCSS is a utility-first CSS framework for modern CSS (anchor positioning, container queries, view transitions,
scroll-driven animations, light-dark(), OKLCH colors, logical properties). Docs: https://omniacss.eu/docs/

## Rules for writing OmniaCSS markup
- OmniaCSS is NOT Tailwind. Many names match, many do not. Check every class you are unsure of with lookup_classes
  before you use it; it also corrects typos. Use convert_tailwind to turn Tailwind classes into OmniaCSS ones.
- The spacing scale is not Tailwind's: p-1 is 1rem, p-4 is 4rem. lookup_classes shows the exact value of every class.
- Variants stack with colons: md:hover:bg-vividblue-80. Breakpoints sm 36rem, md 50rem, lg 64rem, xl 80rem,
  2xl 96rem (min-width). Container queries: cq-md: (needs a container ancestor). list_variants shows them all.
- Colors: utilities use the palette (Omnia colors like vividblue-80, HTML names like coral, RAL like ral3020):
  bg-<color>, text-<color>, border-<color>. The semantic theme tokens (--oc-background, --oc-foreground,
  --oc-primary, --oc-border …) switch with light and dark mode; use them in your own CSS with var(). color_tokens
  lists both.
- Components (buttons, cards, modals …) and page blocks come from OmniaUI (separate packages @birdycom/omniaui and
  @birdycom/omniaui-blocks) and use the oc- prefix (oc-btn, oc-card). Before writing a component yourself, look it
  up with list_components and take its reference markup from get_component.

## Install
CDN (prototyping, full build):
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@birdycom/omniacss@0.12.4/dist/omnia.min.css">
Starter build (common utilities only, small):
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@birdycom/omniacss@0.12.4/dist/omnia.starter.min.css">

npm with PostCSS / Vite / Laravel (only the CSS the project uses):
  npm install -D @birdycom/omniacss
  // postcss.config.js
  import omniacss from "@birdycom/omniacss/postcss";
  export default { plugins: [omniacss({ content: ["src/**/*.{html,js,vue,tsx}", "resources/views/**/*.blade.php"] })] };
  /* in the CSS entry */
  @omnia;

CLI (no PostCSS setup):
  npm install -D @birdycom/omniacss-cli
  npx omniacss init
  npx omniacss build --watch

The build only keeps classes it finds written out in the source. Never build class names from pieces
(`text-${color}`): write the full names or list them under "keep" in omnia.config.json.

## Dark mode
Set class="dark" or data-theme="dark" on <html>, or follow the system setting. The dark: variant covers both.

## Moving from Tailwind
  npm install -D @birdycom/omniacss-migrate
  npx omniacss-migrate scan .              # how many classes are covered
  npx omniacss-migrate setup . --write     # switch deps, Vite/PostCSS config and CSS; Tailwind names keep working
  npx omniacss-migrate codemod . --write   # rewrite classes to native OmniaCSS names where they match 1:1
Bootstrap 3/4/5: npx omniacss-migrate bootstrap scan . / bootstrap codemod . --write

## Values of common classes

| Class | CSS |
|---|---|
| p-0 | `padding: 0rem; /* 0px */` |
| p-0.5 | `padding: 0.5rem; /* 8px */` |
| p-1 | `padding: 1rem; /* 16px */` |
| p-1.5 | `padding: 1.5rem; /* 24px */` |
| p-2 | `padding: 2rem; /* 32px */` |
| p-3 | `padding: 3rem; /* 48px */` |
| p-4 | `padding: 4rem; /* 64px */` |
| gap-1 | `gap: 1rem; /* 16px */` |
| gap-2 | `gap: 2rem; /* 32px */` |
| m-1 | `margin: 1rem; /* 16px */` |
| w-1 | `width: 1rem; /* 16px */` |
| w-10 | `width: 10rem; /* 160px */` |
| font-1 | `font-size: 1rem; /* 16px */` |
| font-1.5 | `font-size: 1.5rem; /* 24px */` |
| font-2 | `font-size: 2rem; /* 32px */` |
| round-2 | `border-radius: 0.25rem; /* 4px */` |
| rounded-lg | `border-radius: 0.5rem; /* 8px */` |
| none | `display: none;` |
| align-items-center | `align-items: center;` |

## Tailwind class → OmniaCSS

Generated with the conversion table of @birdycom/omniacss-migrate. "—" means there is no native class: the migrate
plugin can keep the Tailwind name working, or write the CSS yourself.

| Tailwind | OmniaCSS | Note |
|---|---|---|
| flex | flex | same name in OmniaCSS |
| inline-flex | inline-flex | same name in OmniaCSS |
| grid | grid | same name in OmniaCSS |
| hidden | none | native OmniaCSS class |
| block | block | same name in OmniaCSS |
| items-center | align-items-center | native OmniaCSS class |
| justify-between | justify-between | same name in OmniaCSS |
| gap-2 | gap-0.5 | native OmniaCSS class |
| gap-4 | gap-1 | native OmniaCSS class |
| p-2 | p-0.5 | native OmniaCSS class |
| p-4 | p-1 | native OmniaCSS class |
| px-4 | p-inline-1 | native OmniaCSS class |
| py-2 | p-block-0.5 | native OmniaCSS class |
| m-4 | m-1 | native OmniaCSS class |
| mx-auto | m-inline-auto | native OmniaCSS class |
| mt-4 | mt-1 | native OmniaCSS class |
| mb-8 | mb-2 | native OmniaCSS class |
| w-full | w-full | same name in OmniaCSS |
| h-full | h-full | same name in OmniaCSS |
| w-1/2 | w-perc-1/2 | native OmniaCSS class |
| max-w-md | max-w-md | same name in OmniaCSS |
| max-w-7xl | max-w-7xl | same name in OmniaCSS |
| min-h-screen | min-h-screen | same name in OmniaCSS |
| text-sm | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| text-lg | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| text-2xl | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| font-bold | font-bold | same name in OmniaCSS |
| font-semibold | font-semibold | same name in OmniaCSS |
| leading-tight | lineheight-tight | native OmniaCSS class |
| rounded | round-2 | native OmniaCSS class |
| rounded-lg | rounded-lg | same name in OmniaCSS |
| rounded-full | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| shadow | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| shadow-lg | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| border | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| border-gray-200 | border-silver-2 | native OmniaCSS class |
| bg-white | bg-white | same name in OmniaCSS |
| bg-gray-100 | bg-linen-30 | native OmniaCSS class |
| bg-blue-500 | bg-vividblue-80 | native OmniaCSS class |
| text-white | text-white | same name in OmniaCSS |
| text-gray-500 | text-black-2 | native OmniaCSS class |
| text-gray-900 | text-shallowblue-50 | native OmniaCSS class |
| hover:bg-blue-600 | hover:bg-blue-30 | native OmniaCSS class |
| dark:bg-gray-800 | dark:bg-shallowblue-40 | native OmniaCSS class (needs a build; the CDN file has no dark: colors) |
| md:flex | md:flex | same name in OmniaCSS |
| lg:grid-cols-3 | lg:grid-cols-3 | same name in OmniaCSS |
| grid-cols-2 | grid-cols-2 | same name in OmniaCSS |
| space-y-4 | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| divide-y | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| opacity-50 | opacity-50 | same name in OmniaCSS |
| transition | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| duration-200 | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| truncate | truncate | same name in OmniaCSS |
| sr-only | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| absolute | absolute | same name in OmniaCSS |
| inset-0 | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| z-10 | z-10 | same name in OmniaCSS |
| overflow-hidden | overflow-hidden | same name in OmniaCSS |
| object-cover | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
| aspect-video | — | no native class; keep the name with the @birdycom/omniacss-migrate PostCSS/Vite plugin |
